name: Sparse Voxel Octree for Real-Time GI
aliases: Sparse Voxel Octree (SVO) for Real-Time GI
definition: A technique to approximate Global Illumination (GI) by computing a sparse voxel octree around the player and traversing it with secondary rays after visibility buffer generation.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree for Real-Time GI is an ID Software technique approximating indirect lighting via dynamic, player-centric voxel traversal optimized for runtime updates and single-bit occupancy storage.
